explanation: In memory-saving mode, the requested-byte path caps max_lh_slots at leafNum-2. The minimum is integer(log2(leafNum)+1). For four taxa these are two and three, respectively, so the warning can fire despite ample requested memory; the slot count is then raised to three. All 127 four-taxon cases, and no other cases, carry the warning in this 415-case snapshot.
scope: Source-based causal explanation consistent with archived logs; no compiled-binary tracing or paired numerical rerun performed. This explains this warning pattern, not all possible memory warnings or other model/convergence warnings. No production settings were changed.
